links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of LLMs on common (COPD) versus rare (RP) disease vignettes
links.effect: LLMs had significantly higher accuracy for COPD than RP across all metrics (P<.001). RP MRR ranged 0.10-0.39 versus COPD 0.82-0.89; RP accuracy was lower and less stable.
links.quote: LLMs demonstrated significantly higher diagnostic accuracy for COPD compared to RP across all metrics (P<.001).

unlisted_practices: Stepwise incremental information disclosure (hypothetico-deductive) evaluation of LLM diagnosis

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the diagnostic performance of four Chinese LLMs across common and rare disease clinical vignettes provided incrementally, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
